tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: Feminine of Gabriel, from the Hebrew gavri, 'my strength', + El, 'God'. Its root is Hebrew g-b-r-ʾ-l. The archangel Gabriel (Luke 1:19). Gabriella is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my strength”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
